definitions.full: H5677. Eber II. עֵ֫בֶר proper name, masculine Eber (perhaps eponym of Hebrews , form inferred from עִבְרִי , compare references there); — 1 'son' of Shelah, and 'grandson' of Arpachshad Gen 10:24 (J) = 1Chr 1:18 ; Gen 11:14-15 , (P); 'father' of Peleg and Joktan 10:25 (J; with especially reference to Joktan 10:26 ff., i.e. to Arabians) = 1Chr 1:19 (compare 1:20 ff.), of Peleg specifically Gen 11:16-17 , (P; with especially reference to Abraham 11:26 f.) compare 1Chr 1:25 (see 1:27 f.); in Gen 10:21 (J) Shem is called כָּלבְּֿנֵיעֵֿבֶר אֲבִי ; ᵐ5 Εβερ . — ׳ע Num 24:24 perhaps (si vera lectio) belongs not here ( = עִבְרִים Hebrews , ᵐ5 Ἐβραίους , so Thes), but below I. עֵבֶר = the (land) beyond (the river), || אַשּׁוּר , so Di Kau. 2 a Gadite chief 1Chr 5:13 , ᵐ5 Ωβηδ , ᵐ5 L Εβερ . 3 Benjamite names: a. 1Chr 8:12 , ᵐ5 Ωβηδ , ᵐ5 L Αβερ . b. 1Chr 8:22 ( עֵבֶר van d. H. Ginsb; עֶבֶד Baer), ᵐ5 Ωβδη , A Ωβηδ , ᵐ5 L Αβερ . 4 a priest Neh 12:20 ᵐ5 L Αβεδ .
